stem: What is the recommended objective method for assessing parental concerns about penile size in a boy?

options.text: Measure the flaccid penile length with a rigid ruler against age-based averages
Rely on subjective visual assessment during the physical examination
Measure the stretched penile length and girth using a flexible tape and plot the result on a male growth chart
Measure penile volume using water displacement
Measure the penile circumference only while flaccid

explanation: Stretched penile length and girth measured with a flexible tape and plotted on a male growth chart is the recommended objective method for assessing penile size concerns.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because flaccid length with a rigid ruler is less standard and less reliable than stretched penile measurement.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a subjective visual assessment does not provide the objective measurement needed to compare with normal ranges.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because stretched penile length and girth measured with a flexible tape can be plotted on a male growth chart to give an objective comparison with normal values.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because water displacement is not the standard method for assessing penile size in this clinical context.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because circumference alone does not provide the recommended objective assessment of penile size and should not replace stretched penile measurement.

source.hint: Consider the specific tool and the state of the penis required for an accurate clinical comparison on a growth chart.
